fields.advancedJsonHelp: These fields populate the per-conversation `trigger` partial that overrides the adapter trigger policy.
fields.allowComputerUseWarning: When on, replies in this channel may fire screenshot, mouse, and keyboard actions on the host. Off by default for IM channels.
fields.allowGoalDrivingPlatform: Runs only where the connector runtime runs — the desktop app (all channels) or `cli serve` (webhook channels). The mobile app can't drive IM goals.
fields.allowGoalDrivingWarning: When off, /goal refuses to start on this IM conversation so a self-driving loop cannot auto-reply without operator review. Off by default.
fields.allowOcrHint: On by default: the assistant may run local OCR on inbound images and documents. Turning it off leaves attachments unread in this conversation.
fields.allowScheduleTools: Allow this conversation's agent to manage schedules
fields.allowScheduleToolsWarning: Exposes create, list, and cancel schedule tools only to this conversation. The agent can mutate only tasks it created. Off by default.

allowedSkills.help: Whitelist accepts exact ids (lark.calendar.list_events) or wildcards (lark.calendar.*). Empty whitelist blocks every built-in skill on this conversation.
allowedSkills.label: Built-in skill allowlist

fields.appendActivityHint: On adapters that can't edit a message in place, post one compact progress line per step during a turn instead of staying silent. On by default; turn off for noisy channels.
fields.applyToAdapter: Apply to all on this adapter
fields.applyToAdapterConfirm: Apply these settings to every conversation under this adapter? This overwrites existing per-conversation overrides for the matching fields.
fields.applyToAdapterTitle: Re-apply these settings to every conversation under this adapter
fields.liveActivityHint: Show a live progress card in chat while the assistant is working (tool count, elapsed time, current action, file edits). On by default; turn off for noisy channels.
fields.modelManagedByTarget: Provider and model are managed by the selected Agent Team or Workflow.
fields.mutedHint: The bot stops answering this conversation entirely — no turn runs and nothing is delivered. Messages still arrive and are stored, and the bot keeps replying in its other conversations.
fields.proactivePushHint: Allow the assistant to proactively push task-complete / error / input-required events back to this conversation. Off by default.
fields.promoteConfirm:
Promote these explicit conversation values to adapter defaults?

{changes}
fields.promotePermissionConfirm: This promotion changes the adapter Built-in Skill ceiling or HITL default and can affect other conversations. Continue?
fields.promoteToAdapterTitle: Promote supported explicit values without rewriting conversation overrides

quietHours.help: Inside this window the bot does not answer this conversation: no turn runs and nothing is delivered. Replaces the bot-wide quiet hours rather than adding to them.

fields.replyQuotingHint: In group and thread chats, reply as a quote of the message that triggered the bot so people can tell what it is answering. Only on platforms that support replies; private chats never quote. On by default; inherits the bot's default when left on.

requireHitlForWrites.help: When off, write-tier skills run without the A2UI confirm card. Destructive skills always require HITL regardless. Defaults on.
requireHitlForWrites.label: Require HITL for write skills

fields.slaResponseMinutesHint: When set, this conversation shows a countdown badge and turns Overdue if no reply is sent within this many minutes (quiet hours excluded). Leave empty for no SLA.
fields.teamBindingHelp: When set, inbound messages dispatch to this Agent Team instead of a single character; progress streams back to the conversation.
fields.workflowBindingHelp: When set (and no team is bound — a team wins), inbound messages run this Visual Workflow instead of a single character; the message text is the trigger payload and progress streams back to the conversation.
